item.title: Operando Time-of-Flight Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry Reveals Iodine-Mediated Redox Chemistry in Solid-State Li–S Batteries
item.description:
با operando طیف‌سنجی جرمی یونی TOF-SIMS، تشکیل ید عنصری و نقش گونه‌های ید در واکنش‌های ردوکس باتری حالت‌جامد Li-S به‌طور مستقیم مشاهده شد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty is a dynamic operando ToF-SIMS platform that directly detects transient species at buried solid–solid interfaces under bias. Its significance lies in revealing iodine-mediated redox chemistry in solid-state Li–S batteries—specifically elemental iodine formation during charging—enabling identification of reactive intermediates in conversion-type batteries, which conventional operando techniques cannot detect.
🏷 solid-state Li-S battery · operando TOF-SIMS · iodine redox chemistry · buried interface · reaction intermediates

item.title: Dual‐Anion Mutual‐Facilitation Effect Directs Surface Reconstruction for Reversible Anion Redox in Cobalt‐Free Li‐Rich Mn‐Based Cathodes
item.description:
دوپینگ هم‌زمان F/S در کاتد لایه‌ای غنی از Li و Mn، بازسازی سطحی و آزادسازی اکسیژن را مهار کرده و ظرفیت ۸۴.۴٪ پس از ۲۰۰ چرخه با افت ولتاژ کم را حفظ می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a mutual-assisted F/S dual-anion doping strategy that overcomes S-induced lattice strain, creating a depth-dependent architecture with regulated oxygen vacancies and a stabilized interphase. This enables reversible anion redox, suppressing oxygen release and voltage decay. Significance: it delivers high capacity retention (84.4% after 200 cycles, 88.63% after 1000 cycles), demonstrating dual-anion doping as an effective route for durable cobalt-free Li-rich cathodes.
🏷 Li-rich Mn-based cathode · dual-anion doping · anion redox · surface reconstruction · voltage decay
